title: Parabolic--Elliptic Dynamics with Local--Nonlocal Coupled Operators
summary: In this paper, we study two local--nonlocal settings for parabolic--elliptic evolution systems. In our problems we have a disjoint partition of the spacial domain $Ω$ as $Ω=A\cup B$ and we first consider a local parabolic equation posed in $A$ with a nonlocal elliptic balance equation acting in the complementary subdomain $B$. Next, we reverse the roles and take a local elliptic equation posed in $A$ coupled with a nonlocal parabolic equation acting in $B$.
